name: computer
description: Desktop computer use: list displays/windows, screenshot windows, read OS accessibility trees with element refs, act on elements, native background input, clipboard. Backed by the oh-my-pi desktop addon.

takeover.title: Input takeover
takeover.description: Window input always runs in the background first. fallback: when a call has no background route, rerun it once in takeover (briefly activates the window, then hands focus back). refuse: never take over the user's pointer/keyboard; such calls fail instead.

max_width.title: Screenshot max width
max_width.description: Largest screenshot width sent to Claude, in pixels. Larger captures are downscaled; input coordinates follow the delivered image.

max_height.title: Screenshot max height
max_height.description: Largest screenshot height sent to Claude, in pixels.
